artifact.name: cross-root-relationships
artifact.purpose: Reconcile the six root-closure tracks, the shared-state baseline, and reconstruction readiness without promoting independent domains into one object model.

scope.counting_rule: Direct caller counts are distinct caller functions from the canonical direct-call xref export. Direct edge counts are individual direct-call rows. Shared-caller counts are set intersections and do not establish object identity, dataflow, or execution order.
scope.gameplay_count_source: Phase-0 shared-state baseline and reconstruction-readiness foundation projections.

conclusion.overall: The roots form a shared Simulator state substrate with multiple cooperating owner/state domains, not one larger object or one undifferentiated singleton.
conclusion.strongest_shared_owner: Simulator::sSpacePlayerData is one authoritative state container behind 01021260 (+0x04), 01021080 (+0x10), and 01021300 (+0x18/+0x1c). The three roots do not derive navigation context from the empire cache; they share the backing structure only.
conclusion.global_service_result: 00b3d300, 00b3d2a0, and 00b5b800 expose distinct global-slot/forwarding contracts. Their common callers show shared subsystem plumbing, not aliasing.
conclusion.manager_result: 00b3d2a0 is cStarManager-compatible as a receiver for empire and relationship operations. cGameNounManager and cStarManager remain separate owner families until global-slot provenance is resolved.
conclusion.noun_result: 00b21340 and 00b25f40 operate on a cGameNounManager-layout noun registry. 00b1fdb0 is a receiver+0x54 avatar accessor whose owner is strongly but not directly pinned to cGameNounManager. These are related noun-domain contracts, not evidence that 00b3d2a0 and the noun receiver are the same object.
conclusion.implementation_boundary: Expose separate typed ports for service/context handles, input/mode, space state, empire identity, noun/game-data, avatar, and opaque strategy state. Do not flatten the roots into one object.

state_domains.independence: No direct root-to-root edge; each has a different read or forwarding contract. Shared caller intersections do not merge the slots.

state_domains.backing: DAT_0167eaf8 cGameInputManager global and separate game-mode-manager state.
state_domains.commonality: 64 b5 callers also call 00b3d350; 171 callers of 00b3d300 also call 00b3d350.
state_domains.independence: Input mode fields and b5's forwarded +0x20 value are different owners and value domains; no direct b5-to-input dataflow is established.

state_domains.backing: SpacePlayerData+0x04 active planet, +0x10 context, with +0x08 active star in the candidate replacement writer.
state_domains.commonality: 01021260 and 01021080 have 61 direct common callers; 010219b0 directly calls 00b3d2a0 while replacing +0x04/+0x08.
state_domains.independence: Readers do not mutate or allocate; 01021300 uses different fields of the same backing object and is not a context projection.

state_domains.backing: SpacePlayerData+0x18/+0x1c cache and cStarManager-compatible mEmpires map at +0x150.
state_domains.commonality: 01021300 directly calls both 00b3d2a0 and 00ba9370; 70 callers directly call 00b3d2a0 and 01021300; 48 directly call 01021300 and 00ba9370.
state_domains.independence: The manager receiver is not shown to be the SpacePlayerData object, cGameNounManager, or cGameInputManager; the global-slot alias remains unresolved.

state_domains.backing: cGameNounManager mNouns/mNounMap, kCivilization vector records, and the probable mpAvatar field at receiver+0x54.
state_domains.commonality: 00b25f40 directly calls 00b21340; 00b25fb0 directly calls 00b25f40 and 01021300; 00b1fdb0 is layout-matched to cGameNounManager::mpAvatar; 00b3d400 returns the named cGameNounManager global.
state_domains.independence: 00b25fb0 does not directly call 00b21340; the noun reach is transitive through 00b25f40. The 12 functions that directly call both 00b21340 and 00b25fb0 are shared consumers, not proof of one receiver object.

state_domains.commonality: 142 direct co-callers of 00b3d300 and 00b5b800; 64 with 00b3d350; 30 with 00b3d2a0.
state_domains.independence: Dominant sentinel comparisons do not dereference the returned value; no concrete receiver class or mode identity is proven.

global_owner_reconciliation.track_a_cstar_manager: 00b3d2a0 returns DAT_0167eae4. Its receiver is used by 00ba9370 at cStarManager-compatible +0x150 and by 00b3d2c0 at relationship-manager-compatible +0x204. The SDK maps the canonical cStarManager::Get to 00b3d3a0 -> DAT_0167eb0c, so exact singleton identity is unresolved.
global_owner_reconciliation.track_c_noun_avatar: 00b1fdb0 reads receiver+0x54, which exactly matches the SDK cGameNounManager::mpAvatar field type/offset. The selected callers prove that the returned word is a current-avatar object pointer, but no persisted call site preserves the ECX path to 00b3d400 or DAT_0167eb60. This is an owner-layout inference, not a global identity proof.
global_owner_reconciliation.track_e_unnamed_noun_context: 00b25fb0 has an ECX cGameNounManager-layout context and reaches 00b21340 only through 00b25f40. Three direct co-callers of 00b3d400 and 00b25fb0 exist, but there are zero direct co-callers of 00b3d400 and 00b21340 and zero direct co-callers of 00b3d400 and 00b25f40 in the canonical direct-call set. Representative consumers often obtain context through 00b3d300, leaving the authoritative noun accessor unresolved.
global_owner_reconciliation.track_d_noun_registry: 00b3d400 -> DAT_0167eb60 is the named cGameNounManager getter; 00b21340 is the high-confidence GetData implementation entry and uses cGameNounManager layout at +0x98. This establishes the noun-manager domain, not a relationship to DAT_0167eae4 or DAT_0167eae0.
global_owner_reconciliation.reconciled_model: The noun and star-manager findings are compatible as separate objects in one Simulator state graph. Track A's cStarManager-compatible receiver, Track C's avatar owner, and Track E's noun context may be cross-domain members of the same noun/identity subsystem, but they are not defensibly one object until receiver provenance and global aliasing are traced.

shared_caller_intersections.interpretation: These are direct co-call sets, not transitive dependency closure and not object equality. They identify routines that consume multiple roots in one body and are useful for bounded consumer experiments.

high_information_shared_callers.meaning: Cross-domain comm/event orchestration; the strongest shared-state integration sample.
Current-player context and manager-owned empire identity in one gameplay function.
Space navigation consumes context and manager boundaries separately.
Creature/tool behavior crosses strategy-state, manager identity, and current-avatar domains.
Creature initialization/state transition uses shared context, input, and opaque strategy state; it does not prove a single receiver object.
Repeated context propagation across noun/player/game-data operations.
High-degree shared consumer; useful for sequencing, not for object identity.

dependency_projections.finding: The primary root set is ranked as prerequisites/foundations; all primary roots have reconstructable_now=false. 00b3d350 is the named decomp-backed exception but is not queued as a replacement target.
dependency_projections.implication: The current Phase-0 product is an interface freeze, not implementation sequencing inferred from root size.

dependency_projections.finding: 00b3d300 has 210 engine-to-gameplay bridge pairs, 00b3d350 has 149, 00b5b800 has 142, and 00e5c780 has 62. 00b21340 is a two-internal-callee map/list and callback bridge. 00c099e0 is identified as a high-semantic-leverage creature initialization/state-transition function joining 00b3d300, 00b5b800, and input state.
dependency_projections.implication: Shared cross-domain routines justify bounded caller experiments, not a global singleton.

dependency_projections.finding: The baseline explicitly separates service handles, input/mode routing, space navigation, player/empire identity, noun materialization, and opaque handles; its prerequisite tree places 00e5c780 under both noun and empire map lookups.
dependency_projections.implication: The cross-root model preserves domain separation while allowing shared consumers and helper reuse.

downstream_constraints.direct_constrained_callers: All 1,097 distinct direct callers are mechanically constrained to a no-argument raw global read; 252 are gameplay callers.
downstream_constraints.constraint: Downstream helpers receive the returned context as a receiver or use the result to resolve player/object/noun/state data. Do not infer a universal pointer field layout from the root return.
downstream_constraints.transitive_consumers: The 232 direct co-callers of 00b3d300 and 00b21340 are shared routines, not noun consumers by edge alone; only bounded caller-body evidence establishes noun use.

downstream_constraints.direct_constrained_callers: All 314 distinct direct callers are constrained to a no-argument DAT_0167eae4 accessor; 101 are gameplay callers.
downstream_constraints.constraint: The returned word must be treated as a cStarManager-compatible receiver only where downstream fields establish it: mEmpires at +0x150, map anchor at +0x154, and relationship manager at +0x204. 134 callers co-call 00ba9370, but co-call alone does not prove receiver identity.
downstream_constraints.transitive_consumers: 01021300 is the direct cache bridge to 00b3d2a0; its 182 direct callers are potential consumers of the cache refresh path, not guaranteed miss-path executions.

downstream_constraints.direct_constrained_callers: All 459 distinct direct callers are constrained to a raw four-byte forwarded value or 0xffffffff; 701 direct-call edges exist.
downstream_constraints.constraint: The 251 callers with adjacent sentinel comparisons and 373 such edges are scalar/state-gate consumers; the result must not be dereferenced as a normal object without new evidence. The 64 input co-callers and 142 00b3d300 co-callers show shared routines only.
downstream_constraints.transitive_consumers: None established from the root's own forwarding path; it is a leaf wrapper plus two helpers.

downstream_constraints.direct_constrained_callers: All 614 distinct direct callers are constrained by the named cGameInputManager* return and SDK field map; 80 are gameplay callers.
downstream_constraints.constraint: The returned pointer is a borrowed input/mode manager; mLastGameMode +0x18 and mCurrentGameMode +0x1c are separate from SpaceContext and b5's +0x20 forwarded field.
downstream_constraints.transitive_consumers: The 64 b5 co-callers are shared input/subsystem routines, not b5 result dataflow consumers.

downstream_constraints.direct_constrained_callers: All 262 distinct direct callers are constrained to a null-guarded read of active-planet storage; 68 are gameplay callers.
downstream_constraints.constraint: Callers must handle null and must not treat the accessor as planet allocation. Its +0x13c consumer use is not a root field contract.
downstream_constraints.transitive_consumers: The 33 direct co-callers of 01021260 and 00b21340 are shared routines; no direct edge from 01021260 to 00b21340 is present.

downstream_constraints.direct_constrained_callers: All 303 distinct direct callers are constrained to a raw receiver+0x54 pointer read; 68 are gameplay callers.
downstream_constraints.constraint: Pointer equality, null checks, and type checks are pointer operations. The result is a borrowed avatar object; do not assign the receiver to DAT_0167eae4, DAT_0167eae0, or DAT_0167eb60 without ECX provenance.
downstream_constraints.transitive_consumers: The 218 00b3d300 co-callers, 77 00b3d2a0 co-callers, and 65 00ba9370 co-callers are shared identity/context routines, not proof that the avatar owner is the manager receiver.

downstream_constraints.direct_constrained_callers: All 254 distinct direct callers are constrained by the ECX noun-manager-like ABI, five stack arguments, manager-owned vector return, and noun-ID/materialization behavior; 50 are gameplay callers and 318 direct edges exist.
downstream_constraints.constraint: The function is the high-confidence GetData implementation entry, not the SDK's boundary-contaminated 0x00b212d0 address. Preserve lower-bound, needsUpdate, callback, and borrowed-vector semantics.
downstream_constraints.transitive_consumers: 00b25f40 has 64 direct callers/80 edges and directly calls 00b21340. 00b25fb0 has 100 direct callers/193 edges and reaches 00b21340 through 00b25f40 on the non-fallback path. Therefore 00b25fb0 callers are potential transitive noun consumers, while only the 12 functions directly calling both roots are direct co-callers.

downstream_constraints.direct_constrained_callers: All 182 distinct direct callers are constrained by the SpacePlayerData +0x18/+0x1c cache and cEmpire+0x84 identity contract; 47 are gameplay callers and 246 direct edges exist.
downstream_constraints.constraint: Cache hit is identity-only; miss/ID -1 behavior, successor caching, AddRef/Release order, and no-null-global assumption must be preserved.
downstream_constraints.transitive_consumers: The root directly calls 00b3d2a0 and 00ba9370 on refresh. Its 182 callers are potential consumers of the empire identity contract, but the lookup path is conditional and not executed on every cache hit.

downstream_constraints.direct_constrained_callers: All 175 distinct direct callers are constrained to a direct SpaceContext enum read with no null guard; 38 are gameplay callers and 230 direct edges exist.
downstream_constraints.constraint: Preserve None=-1, Planet=0, SolarSystem=1, Galaxy=2; do not reinterpret as a pointer or game-mode ID.
downstream_constraints.transitive_consumers: The 14 direct co-callers of 01021080 and 00b21340 are shared routines, not direct noun transitions; the noun path is transitive through 00b25fb0/00b25f40 and is not a SpaceContext writer path.

downstream_constraints.direct_constrained_callers: All 100 distinct direct callers are constrained by the noun-manager-layout context, 01021300 dependency, and one-word fallback; 36 are gameplay callers and 193 direct edges exist.
downstream_constraints.constraint: When 01021300 is null, return the caller fallback; when an empire exists but no matching civilization exists, return null. The result is borrowed and cCivilization-compatible only on the resolved path; fallback type remains open.
downstream_constraints.transitive_consumers: The 100 direct callers are potential transitive noun consumers through 00b25f40 -> 00b21340, but fallback calls do not traverse the noun root. The 12 direct 00b21340/00b25fb0 co-callers are direct shared consumers, not the size of the transitive set.

downstream_constraints.direct_constrained_callers: All 136 distinct direct callers are constrained by the ECX registry context, uint32 ID, lower-bound/ceiling return, and 0xffffffff/end null behavior; 35 are gameplay callers and 191 direct edges exist.
downstream_constraints.constraint: Callers requiring exact political identity must compare returned cEmpire+0x84 to the requested ID or guarantee key existence. The result is borrowed and no AddRef/Release occurs in the lookup.
downstream_constraints.transitive_consumers: 01021300 is the direct cache bridge; 48 functions directly call both 01021300 and 00ba9370, while 134 functions co-call 00b3d2a0 and 00ba9370 without proving a single execution chain.

initialization_and_teardown.global_service_roots: No initialization, allocation, teardown, lock, or direct global write is established in 00b3d300, 00b3d2a0, or 00b5b800. Their read-only global slots and borrowed forwarding contracts must remain independent of inferred constructor order.
initialization_and_teardown.space_state: 01021d40 is the reported SpacePlayerData allocator/initializer; 010219b0 is a candidate reference-replacement writer for +0x04/+0x08; 01021960 is a candidate +0x10 context writer. Whole-object teardown and exact field initialization order are not committed.
initialization_and_teardown.identity_state: 01021300 performs the only primary-root cache mutation: validates +0x18 against +0x1c and cEmpire+0x84, then AddRefs/stores/Releases on replacement. It is identity state, not a navigation or input transition.
initialization_and_teardown.noun_state: 00b3d400 returns a borrowed named noun-manager singleton; 00b21340 materializes manager-owned map/vector state and clears needsUpdate. CreateInstance/DestroyInstance invalidation writers and whole-manager teardown are not closed.
initialization_and_teardown.opaque_state: 00b5b800 and its helpers perform no mutation, allocation, reference operation, or teardown; receiver lifetime is unresolved.

highest_impact_remaining_ambiguity.ambiguity: Whether DAT_0167eae0 and DAT_0167eae4 are aliases, wrappers, or independent instances relative to DAT_0167eb60 (cGameNounManager) and DAT_0167eb0c (canonical cStarManager::Get), and whether the ECX receivers observed at 00b1fdb0/00b25fb0 come from those named getters.
highest_impact_remaining_ambiguity.why_highest_impact: This ambiguity determines whether service context, star/relationship management, avatar ownership, and noun/game-data materialization are ports on distinct owners or one shared manager. It is the boundary that can invalidate otherwise correct downstream field and fallback constraints.
highest_impact_remaining_ambiguity.smallest_static_experiment: In a read-only scratch view, trace writers and final ECX provenance for the four globals DAT_0167eae0, DAT_0167eae4, DAT_0167eb60, and DAT_0167eb0c through 00b3d2c0/00ba9370, 00b3d400, 00b3d3a0, and the selected 00aebe90/00bff2d0/00cfbc10 caller windows. Record only direct global writers, getter return propagation, and the last definition of ECX before 00b1fdb0/00b25fb0. No runtime or type mutation is required.
